## Objective

Condition data-only field information on pose using a rank-aware solve, compute prior-relative local sensitivity/effective dimension, and combine it with residual projection, selection improvement and regional stability. Freeze nonlinear presets using training data only.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 9.4, FA-10N. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `nonlinear selection and refit validation`
- `nonlinear preset training records`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Independent rank/nullspace fixtures separate data information from damping/prior conditioning.
2. Smallest supported model is retained; declared simpler fallback is explicit and cannot count as nonlinear success.
3. Selection/audit roles, subject split, thresholds and partial/prior-controlled admission are observable and reproducible.

## Blocking prerequisites

- N08 (`bd-01M2B118HZW9046EKXSBWQWDSE`): FA-N08: Integrate and falsify rigid-plus-PE registration
- N11 (`bd-01M2B118YVEFCRRQT9HRY3W2N8`): FA-N11: Integrate and qualify small-strain anatomical fitting
- L17 (`bd-01M2B116JT6ZP5KYNDV7MJ8NVJ`): FA-L17: Implement linear selection, audit and regional QC
- L20 (`bd-01M2B116ZF7SG4NQCAWXNM36TW`): FA-L20: Calibrate and freeze linear modality presets on training data

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
